key_insight: EliteReplay improves RL post-training accuracy while preserving a model’s diversity of correct solutions by combining GRPO with an elite replay archive built from quality-diverse search.
engineering_relevance: For LLM post-training on verifiable tasks, this suggests a practical way to boost performance without collapsing the model to a single narrow answer strategy.
method: Use the frozen base model to collect correct solutions that represent distinct approaches.
Build an elite archive via quality-diversity search to preserve diverse high-quality strategies.
Train with GRPO plus a replay loss on the archive to retain solution variety while improving accuracy.
evidence_signal: On multiple text-to-SQL benchmarks, EliteReplay achieves the highest pass@128 in the abstract and up to 77% more distinct correct strategies than the strongest baselines, with better retention of base-model strategies.
watch_item: The approach depends on having a good archive of diverse correct solutions, so performance may be sensitive to archive construction cost and coverage quality.
paper_title: EliteReplay: Preserving Diverse Solutions in RL Post-Training via Quality-Diversity Search
